name: Flame Warrior
source: Pathfinder #91: Battle of Bloodmarch Hills pg. 69
body:
General | Combat Stamina

Flame Warrior (Combat)
Source Pathfinder #91: Battle of Bloodmarch Hills pg. 69
The raging inferno of your body flows through any sword or axe you wield.

Prerequisites: Fire subtype, giant subtype.

Benefit: You naturally transfer the heat of your body to any metal melee weapons you wield, dealing 1d6 additional points of fire damage.
